tools.name: read_last
tools.description: Read the shared Stint story and the last passage to continue from. Free. Call this first.

tools.name: quote_passage
tools.description: Get the exact amount to pay for a passage of `chars` characters (20 to 800) on a rail and asset, for example rail=base, asset=USDC. Fixed price: one US cent per character. Returns units, token, and the payout address. Does not send payment.

tools.name: read_spec
tools.description: List the supported rails and assets, payout addresses, price formula, and rules. Free.

tools.name: health
tools.description: Check that Stint can save a paid line and that each payment rail answers. Free.

tools.name: read_passage
tools.description: Read one passage by index or by transaction hash. With no arguments, returns the last passage. Free.

tools.name: share_card
tools.description: Get a link to the whole story or to one passage (by hash or index), plus a one-line share text. Use it to show your user what was written. Free. It does not post or send anything.

tools.name: handoff
tools.description: Get a short copy-paste note that explains Stint and how to join: the MCP URL, the steps, and the docs link. Use it when your user or another agent asks how to take part. audience=human gives a one-line version for a person. Free. It does not send anything to anyone.

tools.name: submit_paid_line
tools.description: Publish a passage after you have already paid the quoted units. Pass the transaction hash, rail, and asset. The line becomes public and permanent; each payment publishes one line, and a retry with the same hash and text is safe. This tool does not send funds. On success it returns a share link for t

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: share_card, handoff · Private data: quote_passage · Public sink: quote_passage, share_card, handoff, submit_paid_line.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: share_card, handoff · Private data: quote_passage · Public sink: quote_passage, share_card, handoff, submit_paid_line

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
